points.label: MCP endpoint reads as the bare origin
points.summary: The MCP URL we hand out lost its /mcp tail. Open Settings → MCP server. PASS: the Endpoint row reads exactly https://mcp.deepresearch.se with no path after the host, and the 'claude mcp add' command below it carries the same bare URL. FAIL: either still shows /mcp on the end. Both forms still answer — this point is about what the screen advertises, not about what works.

actions.text: Settings (gear) → MCP server. Read the Endpoint row and the command box under the key.

points.label: The setup page answers on the bare origin, from a phone
points.summary: Open https://mcp.deepresearch.se in the phone browser — no path, no key needed. PASS: the 'Connect an MCP client' page loads, the command under '2. Add the server' shows the bare URL, and there is an 'On a phone' section explaining that the mobile app needs a custom connector and that this server does not speak that flow yet. FAIL: a 404, a sign-in page, or a page still telling you to use .../mcp.

actions.text: Also try typing just mcp.deepresearch.se into the phone browser with no path — it serves this same page. Signed out is fine; the page is public.
